summary: Cred and Duck discuss a challenging market environment where Bitcoin is down 10% from 100k to 90k while many altcoins and meme coins are down 60-70%. They note that nearly all major assets (BTC, ETH, SOL) have experienced failed breakouts on higher timeframes, creating significant pain for altcoin holders. The hosts emphasize that XRP stands out as the only chart showing genuine strength, while ETH continues to disappoint at monthly support around 2.9k. They warn that meme coins like WIF and POPCAT have collapsed despite Bitcoin being near all-time highs, and predict the AI narrative will replace memes as the dominant speculation theme. Key levels discussed include 90k BTC support (heavily tested), 98-102k resistance, ETH 2.9k support with 2.4k invalidation, and SOL needing to reclaim 210+ to look constructive.
key_takeaways: BTC 90k support has been tested multiple times - Duck warns of potential wipeout below if it fails, with gaps down to weekly levels below
ETH holding monthly support around 2.9k but deeply underperforming - if this breaks, 1.9k is next major support
Meme coins (WIF, POPCAT) down 70% while BTC near highs - only DOGE and PEPE holding up as 'blue chip' memes
XRP is the strongest chart besides BTC - consolidating after vertical move with potential for second leg higher
Failed breakouts across major assets (BTC, ETH, SOL) on higher timeframes - worst bull market conditions for altcoin holders
